Instructions for Use
Device description: The Ember Vena Cava Filter is a vena cava filter. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5 Tesla only): slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s per axis; B1+rms <= 2.8 μT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 2 W/kg or less; Normal Operating Mode.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
